question: In ___________ 2026, World Athletics Cross Country Championships will be held in USA.
solution:
The correct answer is __**January**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **World Athletics Cross Country Championships** is a biennial event organized by **World Athletics**, aimed at promoting long-distance running. 
• The upcoming **2026 World Athletics Cross Country Championships** is scheduled to be held in the **United States**, marking a significant event for athletics in the country. 
• The event will take place in the month of **January 2026**, aligning with the traditional timing of the championships, which usually occur in the early months of the year. 
• This will be a historic occasion as it highlights USA’s growing influence
